free_tier.stated: No free trial; pay-as-you-go with no minimum commitment. Billing is per second while an instance runs. Prices are per GPU-hour by priority tier, with vCPU and RAM included: RTX 4090 24 GB USD 0.440 High, 0.347 Medium, 0.253 Low, 0.160 Lowest. Classes below the table start at USD 0.015 per GPU-hour at Lowest priority; CPU-only groups are USD 0.005 per vCPU-hour and USD 0.001 per GB-RAM-hour. Medium and Low can be preempted after roughly 30 minutes.
